## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related Issue.

## Validation

List commands/checks run and the OS tested. Include screenshots for UI changes.

## Model or experiment changes (if applicable)

Record the model ID, dependency setup, checkpoint location/hash and evaluation configuration. Distinguish integration checks from measured playing strength.

## Review notes

Mention remaining limitations and any API, reward, observation or packaging changes that teammates must account for.

- [ ] The relevant checks passed, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation matches the change.
- [ ] The diff contains no local environment, personal interpreter path, bulk training output or unintended checkpoint.
